Non-delivery of items and no automatic refund too. A regular customer of Blinkit here. However, of late, there is a tendency that items are either not available or not delivered, and shown as delivered. The delivery person doesn’t inform you about non-availability of the items/items not being delivered. After delivery, one has to check item-wise, and make sure everything has been delivered, which is quite a task. And then one has to contact the customer care for redelivery/refunds. No automatic processing from Blinkit’s end, unlike other platforms like Milk Basket. 

I ordered twice on Blinkit today, and both the times, items were missing. On contacting customer care, I was informed that some items were not available, and some were available, but not delivered. And in case of small value items, they don’t do re-delivery, they only process refunds, that too without refunding handling / delivery charges. 

Extremely unprofessional attitude from Blinkit!!
